title: [MDT] Profile wont apply if basal unchanged
body: Behaviour: User edits profile, saves and applies it. Profile is saved to NS, but not applied. How to reproduce: 1. Using Medtronic pump (only its owners report this) 2. Edit IC/ISF/Name in profile, leaving basals untouched 3. Save, apply. See logs ``` D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandQueueImplementation.isThisProfileSet():659]: Current profile: EPS(...) I/PUMP: [MedtronicPumpPlugin.setNewBasalProfile():1103]: MedtronicPumpPlugin::setNewBasalProfile D/PUMP: [MedtronicPumpPlugin.isProfileSame():495]: Current Basals (h): 0,350 0,350 0,300 0,350 0,350 0,650 0,650 0,700 0,850 0,850 0,600 0,500 0,500 0,400 0,400 0,350 0,350 0,350 0,350 0,350 0,400 0,400 0,400 0,350 D/PUMP: [MedtronicPumpPlugin.isProfileSame():513]: Requested Basals (h): 0.350 0.350 0.300 0.350 0.350 0.650 0.650 0.700 0.850 0.850 0.600 0.500 0.500 0.400 0.400 0.350 0.350 0.350 0.350 0.350 0.400 0.400 0.400 0.350 D/PUMP: [MedtronicPumpPlugin.isProfileSame():515]: Basal profile is same as AAPS one. ``` After this profile apply is cancelled and old profile remains active despite having changes in IC/ISF/Naming. This is how it looks like in treatments: profile changes having only `PS` tag, but no `PH` were not applied at all. As you can see - there were no profile switches until 14:11 that day, despite being saved and applied and shown in treatments.
